claude_command.label: Claude command
claude_command.description: Path or name of the claude binary (point at a wrapper to sandbox it)

transcripts_dir.label: Transcripts directory
transcripts_dir.description: Claude projects dir used to reload past conversations; empty auto-derives from the workspace path (sandboxed claude wrappers must set this explicitly)

model.label: Default model
model.description: Model new chats start with; custom aliases from the Models list are pickable per-chat but only via 'First in list' here

models.label: Models
models.description: Model aliases offered by the in-panel switcher

effort.label: Effort
effort.description: Default reasoning level for new chats

allow_tools.label: Allow tools
allow_tools.description: Off (default): claude runs with all tools disabled. On: claude's default tool behavior.
